scope: Actual local static-demo browser interactions and layout; not deployment, backend, real-model, HTTPS or automated visual-design approval.

checks.name: local page opens in a fresh browser context without a user profile
the first keyboard stop reveals a skip link and Enter focuses the workspace
initial attendance answer links to the original source at line three
version comparison shows only the labelled deadline excerpts and opens both original sources
legal example withholds advice and discloses that no review is submitted
audit view and downloaded JSON reflect the selected legal replay
browsing another source clears the citation highlight and returning focuses the cited source
document filtering reports both real matches and an honest empty state
research offers three explicit replay cases without a question form or answer-generation control
a rejected clipboard operation displays failure rather than claiming success
keyboard activation selects an explicit example and citation navigation restores the invoking button
Find anything opens a native dialog with labelled search and Escape restores its opener
both Ctrl K and Command K toggle workspace search and restore the selected case button
command search filters sources, scenarios and views without inventing an empty-result destination
command options expose selection and arrow keys plus Enter choose the selected document version
Focus reading toggles the desktop sidebar while retaining the active example
the source reader shows the cited line in a native dialog and closes with focus restoration
copy feedback remains pending until a controlled clipboard promise resolves
a clipboard completion cannot overwrite feedback after switching examples
1440px layout fits the research, documents, audit, command palette and source reader
1024px layout fits the research, documents, audit, command palette and source reader
768px layout fits the research, documents, audit, command palette and source reader
390px layout fits the research, documents, audit, command palette and source reader
320px layout fits the research, documents, audit, command palette and source reader

clipboard_test: Controlled rejected and deferred/resolved promises in an isolated browser context; no system clipboard access
